steps.name: What should I do? (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Ricota] at “Nereis Gate” and visit [Hayden] at “Aie Island.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ah, %s… . Are you at the gate yet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was just looking at the scenery here.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You said so.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Actually, it wasn't a big deal, I just thought I wanted to go and sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you uncomfortable with the accommodation provided by the gateway?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's comfortable, but I can't get a good night's sleep because it's not my room.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I can sleep deeply only if my room is full of dolls and my bed is soft.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't have nightmares... . If I'm even the slightest bit anxious, I can't sleep... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you usually have nightmares?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The image of myself before I did this and the times I was in continue to appear in my dreams. Most people who use this kind of power will do that... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If you sleep well, you won't even think about that... . It's been a little difficult since I came here.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think I can fall asleep quickly if I sleep holding a pretty and cute doll.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Although the dolls look a little different after visiting the island... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hahaha... . Still, why don’t you get some sleep while you’re resting?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … I left my attachment doll behind... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Raclette made it... , I guess it’s because I don’t have it… . Like a child. Actually, it's a young child... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone has one or two things they cherish. Is that so?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I go to Hayden and ask if he has a good doll?)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's because I suddenly remembered something to see.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Is that so? You must be busy, but I've been holding on for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Then I will come back quickly.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Where? Oh, you're already gone.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Uh… . I'm heading towards the gate, but... .

steps.name: What should I do? (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Scylla] in “Mirror of the Abyss” and obtain <Ficus Mini Doll>. Then, return to [Ricotta] at the “Nereis Gate” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello %s.
(Hayden approaches and says hello. Marie, who is being held by Hayden, also blinks and seems to say hello.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, hello. Marie too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm here because I have a favor to ask Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Please speak. I will help you with anything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Hayden briefly about Ricotta’s situation.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The driver needs a good doll. As for the remaining dolls... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: There are only things that spirits live in... .  If you talk to those kids, they'll be playing dead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You shouldn't tell a living spirit to stay dead.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: When Ficus was cursed, he helped many dolls. The skill of inserting cotton and sewing with thread is amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ficus… Are you talking about that bird doll that looks like a woodpecker?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: To be exact, it is a bird called a toucan that lived on the island. Ficus was originally a tall man, but he was cursed when he rejected Circe.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: He wasn't originally here, but somehow he ended up staying. It's a powerful curse, so it remains the same even if Circe disappears.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there any way to break the curse? .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: … If it's a curse that can cause you to appear, it seems like you need god-level power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh, by the way, Ficus made a doll recently. I think you liked being a doll.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Scylla especially liked it and brought a lot with her. He said he felt comfortable just looking at it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes, a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It’s a comfortable doll… . Should I ask for one?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Since you want to help Adventurer, I think you could give me one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should do that. Hayden, where is Scylla right now?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You are now in the Mirror of the Abyss. He said he didn't want to disturb Glaucus, who is maintaining the theater.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back. thank you.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Good luck! Come on, Marie. Let's wish each other good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm a little anxious, but shall we go quickly?)
(The inside of the mirror is still full of various colored glass, beads, and all kinds of mirrors. Standing in that gown is Scylla, wearing a doll hat, as if she had been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: … I was preparing because I felt like a strong being was coming... . It was you, the Adventurer of the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Scylla. This is the first time since that happened, right?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Yes, this is my first time.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I wanted to talk to you about a lot of things, and thank you so much for stopping by.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: As you can see, Circe's curse has not been lifted... . are you okay. My relationship with Glaucus has also become better.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: If I had been a little stronger, I wouldn't have left Circe like that... . Circe… .
(For some reason, I can feel some loneliness in Scylla’s eyes.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Thank you so much for getting Circe off this island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Suddenly, seeing you reminds me of colleagues I was with a long time ago... . We followed God's will and fought against the demons and demons who wanted to devour the continent.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It was a time so long ago that I can't even remember anymore... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: The demons used a lot of force to open the door and take over Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They are demons like Degos. Did it appear and disappear then? .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Do you know that name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. that is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Scylla about what happened with Degos in the past.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Degos appears again, and the door is connected... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Still, I'm glad. Because you follow God... . Degos may not appear anytime soon, but other beings will surely take his place... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Somehow I think we'll see each other again and again. I want to help, but it's hard because I'm in this situation right now. The curse will be lifted someday, but I don't know when that will be.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I'll just wait while I rehabilitate... . Can you help me a little? Help me and I'll give you what you need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … You knew that and suggested it.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Otherwise, there would be no reason for you to come back here.
(Scylla looks at Adventurer with a relaxed expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I would like to ask you for one ficus doll. I wanted to give it as a gift to a friend who helped me with my work on the island.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Is that okay? I want to give something better to my benefactor... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. All you need is what you need right now.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I can't help it when you say that. okay. Then you know the place where the mirror is standing inside, right? Come over there and spar with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Scylla.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I'll go first and wait for you.
(As soon as the words are finished, Scylla runs at high speed towards a space full of mirrors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, should I go too? I have to take the doll back quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. I forgot. Scylla is a very difficult opponent... .
(Scylla, who blocked %s's attack, sits down as if she is exhausted.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I lost. Thanks to you, I felt a lot. I'm still not good enough, so I have to keep training.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: %s, you are so special. When I was brainwashed by Circe and couldn't move, your attack made me wake up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: As promised, I will give you a Ficus doll. You can have nice dreams.
(Scylla reaches for the glass on the wall and starts rummaging through it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Think of it like a big bag. Although it is a space created by Circe, it is quite useful. Being able to put in and take out a lot of things... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Living beings such as people and animals can also enter. You saw it. That child goes in and acts poorly... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Ah, here it is. ruler!
(Scylla removes her hand from the mirror with a bright expression. A bird-shaped doll with a goofy expression appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is it. It was better made than I thought.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Right? Ficus is a doll now, but he's really talented. If you look at the spirit Kanens is in love with.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: He is good at sewing and cutting, making clothes for dolls and repairing broken parts, and is good at gardening and plastering, and is also an expert at steering. Isn't it amazing?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: When making this doll, they even added a scent to relieve fatigue. I heard that the plants on Aie Island have a special scent, but I wasn't sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells like the cool sea.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Right? A long time ago, this place was an island surrounded by the sea.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I didn't see it until later, but when I heard Glaucus tell it, he said it was incredibly beautiful.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: If you give it to your friend, he will fall asleep quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Scylla.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I am more grateful. There have been a lot of things I wanted to talk about, so thank you for dealing with me like this.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I didn't know I was this talkative either. I'm glad to talk to someone after such a long time. It was fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come visit again next time.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I'm alone today, but next time I'll see you and Glaucus together.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Can we say that the witches started moving when the door opened? .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Anyway, meeting Degos... . Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, you were there just now. Now, here… .
(Hand the Ficus mini doll to Ricotta. Although it is smaller than the actual Ficus model, it is just the right size for Ricotta to hug.)
(Ricotta is staring at the doll without saying anything.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Wow… . Wow… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry. I love it… . It's so pretty. So cute... . What should I do?
(The girl, who seemed a bit blunt, was unable to suppress her strong emotions and was unable to let go of the doll.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Alive, no... . Dead… . no. It's just a doll, but such a pretty doll.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I like it because it’s so fluffy. … I liked the doll that Raclette made, and I also like this one... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's so nice that I don't feel any ominous energy, and only feel the skill and affection of the person who made it...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … Oh, I don't know. I just like everything so what should I do… .
(Ricotta is hugging the doll and doesn't know what to do.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. I was worried about what I would do if I didn’t like it… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think a doll like this would help me sleep well. Plus it smells nice. The smell of the sea... . It's like my hometown...
(Ricotta gives a slightly lonely smile.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I guess I got a little excited because it smelled a bit nostalgic. sorry. I guess I was too tired.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't usually show this side of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Rico. Because liking what you like is happiness.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll go to my accommodation. I suddenly felt drowsy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, sleep well then.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: See you later, %s… .
(I heard this story later, but it is said that Ricotta slept soundly and woke up without thinking about anything, as if the sleep fairy had used all her strength to put her to sleep.)
(When Ricotta is sent, a strange-looking creature suddenly flies in front of %s as if it had been waiting from above.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a spirit that only I can see?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? pooh. bloke. ah? What is punom a? Ah, pneuma… . That's right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Arche looking for me in Pneuma?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, okay. Let's go.
